title: Viking sword
description: A fun summer expansion bringing new items, mobs, and a bright seasonal vibe to Minecraft.
body:
# **_⚔️ Viking Sword Mod_**

 **_The mod adds the Viking strength effect found in their axes
 the mod features all kinds of axes, from wooden ones to those made of netherite
 And, of course, these axes will be +2 stronger than regular axes
 You can use them for smashing and fighting_**
